276195: Ittoki's uncle and one of Iga's strongest fighters with a reputation of being called "Tokisada the Demi-God". Despite his laidback attitude, Tokisada is powerful in combat and will not hesitate to go into extremes to complete a mission.
276196: Ninja of Iga Village. She always has her guard up and makes sure Ittoki keeps up with his responsibilities and doesn't slack off.
276197: Ittoki is an upstanding student in school, taking a multitude of advanced classes and even attending a cram school six times a week. He is also very physically capable, taking a gymnastics class three times per week on top of his other extracurricular activities.
276198: Ittoki's mother and the current chief of the Iga village who took over the leadership after the death of her husband. Though she wasn't born into a ninja family, her prudence and courage in the face of death that has earned her the respect of the entire Iga Village.
279935: She's Ittoki and Kosetsu's classmate who appears to be friendly and weak, however unbeknownst to the two and to Suzaku Ban, she's deceptive and manipulative.
279936: She belongs to the Saiga village that is already endangered by disappearing, her village was once known as the technological hub of ninjutsu, where during its heydays was to go to place for ninjutsu tech.
279937: Ittoki's classmate and a ninja from the Koga village. Hiding her ninja status, she "became" Ittoki's temporarily girlfriend in an attempt to kill him.
283066: Ittoki's rival and classmate from the Ninja Academy. He has a strong prejudiced hate against Ittoki for the Iga clan's murder of Koga's head, a man whom Suzaku had highly admired.
